content: Sala, perdaun ho fiar
Jesus hatete ba Nia eskolante sira dehan, “Sempre iha buat ruma mak halo ema monu ba sala. Maibee see mak halo ema seluk monu ba sala, nia sei terus.
Ba nia, diak liu ema kesi fatuk boot ida iha nia kakorok depois soe nia tama ba tasi laran! Tanba se nia halo labarik ida monu ba sala,
nia sei simu kastigu todan liu fali ida nee.
Nee duni imi tenki kuidadu para la bele halo ema seluk monu ba sala! Se imi nia maluk ida halo sala, koriji nia. Se nia hakribi nia sala, foo perdaun ba nia.
Se nia halo sala hasoru o, depois mai dehan, ‘Deskulpa, hau sala’, i husu tiha deskulpa, nia halo sala fali, mai husu deskulpa tan, bele too dala hitu iha loron ida mos, o tenki simu nia.”
Depois apostolu sira husu ba Nai Jesus, “Aumenta tan ami nia fiar!”

Jesus hataan, “Se imi nia fiar kiikoan hanesan mostarda musan ida mos, imi bele foo orden ba ai huun boot ida dehan, ‘Sai tiha husi nee, i muda baa hamriik fali iha tasi laran.’ I ai huun nee sei tuir duni imi nia orden.”
Atan tenki tuir patraun nia hakarak

Jesus foo ezemplu ida dehan, “Hanoin took, imi mak hanesan patraun. Imi nia atan ida baa fila rai iha toos ka hein bibi malae. Bainhira atan nee fila husi servisu, imi konvida kedas nia atu mai haan ka?
Lae! Imi sei haruka dehan, ‘O baa prepara hahaan mai hau lai, depois troka tiha o nia ropa hodi serve hau iha meza. Hotu tiha mak o bele haan-hemu.’
Tuir imi nia hanoin, se atan nee halo tuir buat nebee patraun haruka, patraun sei foo obrigadu ba nia ka? Lae!
Imi mos hanesan. Se imi halo hotu ona servisu nebee Maromak foo, imi tenki hatete, ‘Ami nee atan deit, la serve atu simu obrigadu. Ami so halao deit ami nia obrigasaun.’”
Nai Jesus kura ema moras lepra nain sanulu
Jesus kontinua lao ba Jerusalém. Too dalan klaran, Nia lao tuir baliza entre provinsia Galileia ho Samaria.
Bainhira Nia atu tama ba aldeia ida, mane nain sanulu moras lepra mai atu hasoru Nia. Sira hamriik husi dook deit
hodi bolu ho lian makaas dehan, “Jesus, Mestri, hanoin ami ba!”
Bainhira Jesus haree sira, Nia hatete ba sira, “Imi baa hatudu imi nia isin ba nai lulik sira, para sira haree.” Entaun sira baa. Tuir dalan, derepenti deit sira hotu hetan isin diak.
Ema ida husi nain sanulu nee, bainhira nia haree katak nia diak tiha ona, nia fila kedas ba Jesus hodi hahii dadauk Maromak ho lian makaas.
Too iha nebaa, nia hakneak ho hakruuk too rai iha Jesus nia ain hodi foo agradese ba Nia. Ema nee ema Samaria, laos ema Judeu.
Jesus husu, “Ohin iha ema nain sanulu mak hetan isin diak, loos ka lae? Sira nain sia iha nebee?
Nusaa mak so ema estranjeiru ida nee deit mak fila mai foo agradese ba Maromak?”
Depois Jesus hatete ba ema nee, “O hetan kura tanba o fiar mai Hau. Hamriik ba. Bele baa ona.”
Nai Jesus koalia kona ba Nia fila fali mai husi lalehan
Iha loron ida, ema Farizeu balu mai husu Jesus, “Bainhira mak Maromak komesa ukun nudar Liurai?” Jesus hataan, “Maromak halao nia ukun iha mundu, laos buat ida nebee ema bele haree ho matan.
Nunee ema la bele dehan, ‘Maromak ukun iha nee’ ka, ‘Nia ukun iha nebaa.’ Tanba Maromak ukun iha ema nia laran.”
Depois Jesus hatete ba Nia eskolante sira, “Iha tempu oin mai, imi sei hakarak teb-tebes atu haree Hau, Ema Umanu nia Oan fila fali mai, maibee la haree.
Ema sei hatete ba imi, ‘Ema Umanu nia Oan iha nee’ ka, ‘Nia iha nebaa.’ Lalika fiar.
Tanba bainhira Hau, Ema Umanu nia Oan fila fali mai husi lalehan, ema sei haree mo-moos, hanesan rai lakan makaas foo naroman husi rohan ba rohan.
Maibee Hau tenki hetan terus oi-oin uluk, i ema sira nebee moris agora sei fila kotuk mai Hau.
Bainhira loron too atu Hau, Ema Umanu nia Oan fila fali mai, ema sei moris baibain hanesan iha Noé nia tempu uluk.
Iha tempu nebaa sira haan-hemu i halo festa kazamentu hanesan baibain, too loron Noé tama ba roo boot laran. Derepenti, bee boot sae, halo sira mate mohu.
Nunee mos iha Ló nia tempu. Ema haan-hemu, halo kontratu, halo toos, i harii uma, hanesan baibain.
Maibee iha loron nebee Ló sai husi sidade Sodoma, derepenti deit ahi ho ahi klaak monu tuun husi lalehan, halo ema Sodoma sira mate mohu.
Nunee mos, bainhira Hau, Ema Umanu nia Oan fila mai i ema hotu-hotu haree mo-moos Hau.
Iha loron nee, ema nebee iha hela liur, la bele tama ba uma laran hodi foti nia sasaan. Ema nebee iha hela toos, la bele fila baa foti buat ruma iha uma.
Keta haluha saida mak akontese ho Ló nia kaben.
See mak hakarak salva nia aan, nia sei lakon fali. I see mak lakon nia moris, nia sei hetan moris rohan-laek.
Hau hatete ba imi, bainhira Hau fila mai, ema nain rua toba hela iha kama ida, Maromak sei lori tiha ida, i husik hela ida seluk.
Iha feto nain rua fai hela hare, Maromak sei lori tiha ida, i husik hela ida seluk.
[Iha mane nain rua servisu hela iha toos, Maromak sei lori tiha ida, i husik hela ida seluk.]”

Jesus nia eskolante sira husu, “Nai, buat sira nee sei akontese iha nebee?” Jesus soe lia dehan, “Bainhira imi haree manu metan semo hamutuk ba iha fatin ida, nee sinal hodi hatudu mo-moos katak iha mate isin dodok iha nebaa.”

footnotes.text: Iha nee Lucas hakerek dehan, “See mak halo ida husi kiikoan sira nee monu ba sala”. Matenek nain balu kona ba Biblia hanoin dehan, “kiikoan sira nee” hatudu ba Jesus nia eskolante sira nebee mak fiar sei fraku. Balu tan hanoin dehan, “kiikoan sira nee” hatudu ba labarik ka hatudu ba ema kiik.
Iha Noé nia tempu, ho mos Ló nia tempu, ema barak lakohi rona Nai Maromak. Too ikus Maromak kastigu sira.
Ló nia kaben mate tanba nia hanoin liu nia uma duke Nai Maromak nia orden. Haree Jénesis (Kejadian) 19:26.
Kopia evanjelhu Lucas nian husi tempu antigu barak. Versikulu 36 nee tama iha kopia nee balu. Maibee balu la iha.
Tuir matenek nain balu kona ba Biblia, nee dehan katak, aban-bainrua Nai Jesus atu besik fila fali mai, sei iha sinal hodi hatudu mo-moos katak Nia atu mai ona.
